description: This is a PHP source file defining the UpgraderConfigUtility class, which provides methods for checking database status and connection within the OrangeHRM HRM system's installer utilities.

classes.name: UpgraderConfigUtility
classes.description: Utility class for checking database status and connection during upgrade process.

methods.name: checkDatabaseStatus
methods.description: Checks if the database table 'ohrm_upgrade_status' exists.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a Doctrine DBAL connection object.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Gets the schema manager from the Doctrine DBAL connection.

methods.name: checkDatabaseConnection
methods.description: Establishes and verifies the database connection, throws exception if there is an error or if the database status indicates it should not proceed.
